text: A gate GitHub never started didn't fail. When a job never gets a runner, as when the account's Actions minutes ran out, GitHub marks it failed with no steps, and the public dashboard said "✕ gate failure" on main. The dashboard and the factory's post now read the job's record, and say the gate didn't start. The post says how to go on: re-run the job once CI can run, then `/invariant retry`. Nothing about merging changes, since only a gate that passed merges. A gate that ran and failed now reads "failed" instead of the raw "failure" that #5's post showed. No post or page states a gate result that no gate produced (D-0015).
